title: Contract ops playbook: Clause chooser + SCCs, retention tiers, and subprocessor acceptance matrix
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: build an operational playbook and product primitives that let Sales + Legal rapidly evaluate and accept enterprise data residency requests during negotiations, and to tie retention/residency choices into a pricing experiment. Deliver a ‘Clause Chooser’ UI for negotiators, a Subprocessor Acceptance Matrix with risk tiers for standard vs. negotiated subprocessors, and retention-tier pricing bundles (30/90/365/forever) that are experiment-ready. This ticket covers PM scope: scoping, legal alignment, experiment design, sales training materials, and rollout plan. Background: several enterprise RFPs require explicit EU/UK SCCs plus addenda, limited subprocessor approvals, and shorter retention windows for PII. Legal currently negotiates custom redlines case-by-case; that is slow and leaks margin. We need a governed, auditable decision surface that reduces cycle time, standardizes fallback language, and enables pricing adjustments tied to storage/operational cost. Out of scope for this ticket: implementing HSM/KMS integrations and on-prem installers (those are separate ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Clause Chooser UI wireframes reviewed and approved by Legal and Sales
Subprocessor Acceptance Matrix published with risk categories and approval paths
SCC/UK Addendum templates versioned and available in Contract repo
Backend feature flags to gate negotiated clauses implemented and tested
Pricing experiment configured that maps retention tiers to price adjustments and a measurement plan defined
Sales enablement deck and one-pager published; 2 pilot deal negotiations completed using the flow
Telemetry captures negotiation choices and downstream retention billing impact
work_items: Draft Clause Chooser UX with edge-case flows (opt-in datacenter, EU-only, UK addendum)
Legal to produce approved SCCs + UK addendum drafts and redline policy
Create Subprocessor Acceptance Matrix with standard vendors and required risk controls
Implement backend clause flags and contract template selector in quote generator
Design and run 4-week pricing experiment tying retention tiers to per-unit storage uplift
Instrument telemetry: negotiation choices, signed clauses, retention settings on contracts
Sales pilot: train 3 AE teams and run 2 pilot negotiations; collect qualitative feedback
Update Console onboarding to surface retention-based pricing options
notes_and_decisions: 2026-02-03: Legal recommends defaulting to SCCs + explicit UK addendum for UK-resident data rather than a single pan-EU clause (reduces legal review time for UK customers).
2026-02-18: Decision to expose 4 retention tiers in product and contract UI (30/90/365/forever); retention >365 requires security review and explicit sign-off.

2026-02-24: Trade-off: allowing per-subprocessor negotiation increases legal workload. Accepted compromise: publish matrix with 3 risk bands; Band A (pre-approved) auto-allowed, Band B requires security checklist & POA, Band C requires legal review and pricing uplift.

2026-03-05: Pricing experiment design approved — A/B test where 50% of eligible deals see retention price uplift baked into quote; measurement window = 90 days; KPIs: revenue per deal, win rate delta, time-to-sign.

2026-03-10: Agreed fallback policy for capacity/residency mismatch: if requested region unavailable, auto-offer nearest region + SLA uplift or temporary redaction/KV-masking to meet data residency constraints.
